# Taskly — live demo

> A live demo of Taskly: project and issue tracking with a Kanban board, epics, time tracking, reporting and real-time notifications, built on .NET 10 and Angular 22. A CQRS backend where controllers only dispatch, and a board that updates live over SignalR. The demo data is seeded in memory and resets; this is a portfolio piece, not a product.
